_meta.purpose: Per-NPC roundtrip test fixture per Discipline 1. Mirror of supabase/migrations/20260522155917_seed_v08_content_npc_venn.sql in engine-shape.

engineShape.name: Venn Hook
engineShape.description: A wiry man of indeterminate age, late forties or sixty depending on the angle. Left hand replaced with a long brass weighing-hook — functional, articulated, used as a measuring device with three small chain-graduations. Speaks slowly, smiles slowly, listens fast. Tide League dark-blue tunic; salt-scrip pinned over the heart like a campaign medal.

drive.description: Accumulate enough scrip to exit Greywake before the next major Shattering aftershock; outwardly: stable salt-scrip valuation.

barter.offered: transit record entry with adjustable timing
introduction to a foreign-port broker contact
warning when Bell Court audit window opens
predecessor's name + the records of her case (if player has access)

kill_for.trigger_condition: Imminent personal exposure of the fudged transit records AND escape vector blocked — survival-only trigger

fear_loss.what: his unfudged exit window + the predecessor's fate becoming his own

believes.proposition: Greywake will not survive another aftershock the way it survived the Shattering
My predecessor's fate was civic erasure for unknown cause; the cause was scrip-side too
Self-preservation is the only honest contract

closingConditions.description: Player helps Venn secure exit visa + foreign-port introduction before the next aftershock; Venn departs Greywake intact.
closingConditions.consequence_summary: Venn permanently exits the slice; Tide League loses scrip-side primary broker; player gains foreign-port contact network access.

closingConditions.description: Venn caught by Bell Court audit + struck from ledger like predecessor; OR caught in second-aftershock event he predicted but failed to exit.
closingConditions.consequence_summary: Tide League succession-of-broker crisis; salt-coin-side coalition gains influence; predecessor case re-opens.

closingConditions.description: Venn recognizes player as a better-positioned successor to the broker seat; transfers scrip-warrant access + the predecessor's case records.
closingConditions.consequence_summary: Player inherits Tide League broker seat (commercial economic anchor); transit-record manipulation capability + predecessor knowledge transferred.

closingConditions.description: Venn's exit window closes; he abandons the escape plan and re-commits to long-Greywake survival via deeper Tide League institutional embedding.
closingConditions.consequence_summary: Venn becomes a permanent Greywake fixture; drive shifts to institutional consolidation rather than exit.

residue_drive.description: Maximize Tide League institutional power within Greywake

closingConditions.description: Player provides Venn with information about the predecessor's case that resolves the cosmological-erasure question; Venn becomes a witness rather than a successor.
closingConditions.consequence_summary: Venn becomes a Bell Court witness against Tide League fudging practices; institutional power shift in Bell Court's favor; high-Authority + Bell Court Faith path.

local_pattern.summary: Stations: dawn (scrip-rate review at broker's office) → midday (active brokering with merchants + transit-record entry) → dusk (private accounting + exit-vector planning).
